title: 第26章 一人一个才公平
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
天渊秘境位于望月山脉的最深处。

    不独属于任何一个宗门和世家，所有修真界的修士，只要修为未突破到筑基，便可进入。

    但，秘境的开启需由四大宗门共同开启，因而秘境有重重禁制，若无秘境令牌，根本无法进入。

    青云宗到时，秘境前的空地上已经站满了人。

    各宗各派，甚至是无数散修，早已自成一派。

    此时，晨雾还未散尽，山谷中弥漫着浓郁的花香。

    星元贴在顾念念的耳尖小声说道：“听说这里的天幕花能凝聚气血，提炼肉身强度，等从秘境出来，师侄我带着小师叔去采一批，回去找个丹峰的师兄妹，凝练成丹丸，让小师叔当糖豆吃。”

    顾念念目光顿时一亮。

    大概是乞丐当久了，听到吃的就高兴。

    “呵！”

    空气中忽然传来一声轻哼。

    下一秒，整个天空都被漫天的花雨遮蔽，入眼皆是一片粉色。

    众人一时都看呆了，忘了言语。

    唯有萧易寒的声音在花雨里格外清晰。

    “小师叔不用等，现在这些天幕花都只会是你的。”

    大长老是领队，看到这一幕，不由得摇头。

    下面有人不满，可一看是青云宗的，又纷纷闭了嘴。

    只有少数人还在嘀咕。

    “这青云宗也太霸道了，天幕花虽不是什么稀罕物，可胜在数量多，采集回去也能制成丹药，是散修少数的灵石来源之一。”

    说这话的只能是散修。

    因为无论是宗门还是世家，在凝聚气血，提炼肉身方面都有更高级的丹药，这天幕花实在是用不着，自然也就不会浪费时间去采集。

    三大宗门和七大世家的人，看到青云宗到了，纷纷上前致礼。

    “智源长老，真是别来无恙啊。”

    而声音爽朗，说话之人是个身材极其魁梧的中年汉子，身着藏青色长袍，胸口绣着一座巍峨山峰的图案。

    大长老一看，忙拱手微笑。

    “原来是天阙宗的铁木长老，看来修为又精进了。”

    铁木长老哈哈大笑。

    目光却落在了顾念念的身上，须臾后，眼底划过一抹流光。

    “听说顾衍从凡间带回来一个女儿，想必就是她了。”

    这话听不出什么，很是平常。

    但在这个场合用这样的语气，本身就不寻常。

    智源大长老面带微笑，抬手招来顾念念。

    “念念，这是天阙宗的二长老，铁木长老。”

    顾念念眨巴着眼睛，露出一个乖巧的笑，脆生生地喊了一句：“铁木长老好。”

    铁木长老哈哈大笑，从袖中取出一块青色的玉牌，递了过去。

    “即是顾衍的女儿，我也当得起师伯二字，这个令牌你拿着，无聊的时候可以来我天阙宗，让那帮小崽子们也认识认识。”

    这话看似热情，却带着几分威压。
content_en:
Tianyuan Secret Realm is located in the deepest part of Wangyue Mountain Range.

    Not only belonging to any sect or family, but all monks in the world of cultivation can enter as long as their cultivation level has not reached the foundation level.

    However, the secret realm needs to be opened jointly by the four major sects. Therefore, the secret realm has many restrictions. Without the secret realm token, it is impossible to enter.

    When Qingyun Sect arrived, the open space in front of the secret realm was already full of people.

    Various sects and sects, and even countless casual cultivators, have already formed their own sect.

    At this time, the morning fog has not cleared away, and the valley is filled with the rich fragrance of flowers.

    Xingyuan leaned against the tip of Gu Niannian's ear and whispered: "I heard that the canopy flowers here can condense qi and blood and refine the physical strength. When I come out of the secret realm, my nephew and I will take my junior uncle to pick a batch. I will go back to find a senior brother and sister from Danfeng and condense it into pills for my junior uncle to eat as jelly beans."

    Gu Niannian's eyes suddenly lit up.

    Probably because he has been a beggar for a long time, he is happy when he hears something to eat.

    "Ha!"

    Suddenly there was a soft hum in the air.

    The next second, the entire sky was covered by the rain of flowers, and everything that came into view was pink.

    Everyone was stunned for a moment and forgot their words.

    Only Xiao Yihan's voice was particularly clear in the rain of flowers.

    "No need to wait, little uncle, these canopy flowers will only be yours now."

    The great elder was the team leader, and when he saw this scene, he couldn't help but shake his head.

    Some people below were dissatisfied, but when they saw that they were from the Qingyun Sect, they all shut up.

    Only a few people were still muttering.

    "This Qingyun Sect is too overbearing. Although the Sky Curtain Flower is not a rare thing, it is more abundant in quantity. It can also be made into elixirs when collected. It is one of the few sources of spiritual stones for casual cultivators."

    Those who can only say this are casual cultivators.

    Because both sects and aristocratic families have more advanced elixirs for condensing qi and blood and refining the body. There is really no need for these canopy flowers, so naturally they will not waste time collecting them.

    People from the three major sects and the seven major aristocratic families saw the arrival of the Qingyun Sect and stepped forward to salute.

    "Elder Zhiyuan, you are really well."

    The person who spoke with a hearty voice was an extremely burly middle-aged man, wearing a navy blue robe, with a towering mountain peak embroidered on his chest.

    When the great elder saw it, he hurriedly raised his hands and smiled.

    "It turns out to be Elder Tiemu of Tianque Sect. It seems that his cultivation has improved again."

    Elder Ironwood laughed.

    But his eyes fell on Gu Niannian, and after a moment, a flash of light flashed in his eyes.

    "I heard that Gu Yan brought back a daughter from the mortal world. It must be her."

    There's nothing wrong with this, it's very ordinary.

    But using such a tone on this occasion was in itself unusual.

    Great Elder Zhiyuan smiled and raised his hand to greet Gu Niannian.

    "Nian Nian, this is the second elder of Tianque Sect, Elder Tiemu."

    Gu Niannian blinked her eyes, showed a cute smile, and shouted: "Hello, Elder Tiemu."

    Elder Tiemu laughed loudly, took out a green jade plaque from his sleeve, and handed it over.

    "Even as Gu Yan's daughter, I can also be called master. You can take this token. When you are bored, you can come to my Tianque Sect and let those brats get to know each other."

    These words may seem enthusiastic, but they are somewhat coercive.
